Ranveer Singh becomes Brand Ambassador for Ray-Ban and Ray-Ban Meta

ByET Edge Insights
  • PublishedOctober 5, 2026
FacebookEmailLinkedInXShare
Spotify
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 3:16
Instaread

Bollywood actor Ranveer Singh joins Ray-Ban and Ray-Ban Meta, as its first ever Brand Ambassador for India. Known as a generational performer and one of the most distinctive voices in contemporary Indian culture, Ranveer is impossible to define by a single label. His transformative performances on screen and distinctive approach to style have established him as a singular creative force, consistently pushing boundaries. His instinct to own his identity makes him a natural embodiment of the Ray-Ban spirit.

Ranveer has had a long-standing relationship with Meta with multiple collaborations over the years and the association marks a significant new chapter for Ray-Ban in India, a brand that has spent generations empowering people to see the world – and themselves – through their own authentic lens combined with Meta’s powerful AI technology to lead a new era of expression. Through Ranveer, Ray-Ban and Ray-Ban Meta continue to celebrate the voices shaping contemporary culture in India.

As Brand Ambassador, Ranveer will represent Ray-Ban and Ray-Ban Meta, bringing his creative energy and distinctive point of view to the brand’s evolving story in India. The partnership bridges Ray-Ban’s longstanding connection to culture and self-expression paired with Meta’s cutting-edge technology, introducing new ways for people to experience some of the brand’s most iconic styles.

Ranveer’s association with Ray-Ban Meta demonstrates how iconic styles and technology blend effortlessly into everyday life while still staying true to your individual style – AI glasses that don’t just look great, but deliver value, and help you on the go – whether you’re building healthy habits or navigating a busy calendar – all without reaching for your phone.

Ray-Ban Meta glasses are designed to make everyday moments more seamless like listening to music and podcasts, making hands-free calls or getting quick access to Meta AI. With regular software updates, new AI features, and a growing ecosystem of apps and experiences, these glasses will keep getting better.

Speaking on the association Ranveer Singh says, “Ray-Ban has always stood for individuality, and that is something I have connected with for as long as I can remember. Style, for me, has never been about following a fixed formula – it is about instinct, mood and having the freedom to express every version of yourself. A combination of these iconic styles and cutting-edge technology with Ray-Ban Meta, makes this partnership feel so natural. Ray-Ban’s incredible legacy of people who have done things their own way along with Meta’s vision of building AI glasses for everyone – I’m excited to be a part of that story in India.”

Bringing the partnership to life is a bold new campaign that captures Ranveer’s unmistakable energy, expressive style and instinct for reinvention. Across Ray-Ban and Ray-Ban Meta, the campaign moves between rich, cinematic tones and contemporary silhouettes, reflecting the many sides of his personality while staying rooted in his signature confidence. From timeless Ray-Ban icons to the next generation of Ray-Ban Meta, each frame becomes an extension of Ranveer’s individual style – where heritage, fashion and innovation come together through his distinctly expressive lens.

Through the partnership, Ray-Ban and Ranveer will celebrate the confidence to embrace individuality, experiment without inhibition and Frame Your True Self.
